issues: The author defines Magistery broadly as a principal lifetime pursuit, studied art, delight, action, livelihood or reputation source, not strictly paid employment. Modern occupation codes do not transparently implement this construct.
Three explicitly different questions are whether any profession exists, which type of profession, and what success/fame follows. Success in one must not rescue a miss in another.
Mars, Venus and Mercury each have different source associations with bodily stamina, delight and mind. Planet identity alone does not meet first-tier eligibility.
First tier requires tenth/first/seventh position and essential dignity while excluding combustion and being under Sun beams.
The fallback to one of the three candidates ruling Midheaven still requires essential dignity; peregrine or fall excludes it.
Next selection uses partile Moon aspects, strongest planet, aspect quality, partility and explicit sinister-before-dexter priority, needing original aspect algorithms.

The following Moon-orb fallback appears to refer again to none of the three planets aspecting Moon and then selects one aspecting Moon within half-orb; literal wording is self-ambiguous. Preserve rather than repair.
Moon-orb method rejects malignant corporal conjunction, square or opposition; the source does not provide modern orb weights.
The last source fallback selects from candidate planets anteceding the Sun according to the first mover; original astronomical operator/time ordering is not fully verified.
Negative source says weaker fallback-selected planets may show ignoble profession, negligence or no art, which are different outcomes and reflect historic class stigma.
Lilly also describes an autobiographical method using tenth sign, its ruler and the ruler's house, not an independently registered trial or proven method.
Ptolemy-attributed Sun/morning-riser and Midheaven ruler/occupant two-way method with Moon aspect is historically distinct and has NOT been cross-collated with the original Ptolemaic passage.
The Ptolemy-attributed fallback accepts a planet meeting only one of the two source roles, lowering specificity, without predeclared tie/failure policy.
The next separately numbered CXLIX experimental profession aphorisms begins after divider on same PDF660; no CXLIX substantive content admitted in this packet.
No reliable real human birth-time, vocation timeline, main activity, profession, objective income, comparison chart or control dataset was used to validate any career claim.
The packet is short photographed first-edition anchor/paraphrase documentation, not a complete seventeenth-century diplomatic transcription or executable scoring rule.
